== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tim Anderson]]. Caption "Mr. Anderson"; one person shown.

== Description ==

[[Tim Anderson]] during the Final Confrontation. At the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]], Coach's Corner, Apache Plaza Mall, St. Anthony, Minnesota, 15 June 2002.
